methods.name: GTVI (GLCM and Terrain roughness and Vegetation index) model
methods.summary: A comprehensive remote sensing identification model for ancient landslides that uses Object Based Image Analysis (OBIA) to integrate GLCM entropy, terrain roughness index (TRI), and vegetation index (NDVI) to distinguish ancient landslides from reactivated ones.

availability.author_statement: The original contributions presented in the study are included in the article/supplementary material, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding authors.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or referenced, and the custom GTVI model code is not provided or linked.
